Nina: Postmortem follow-up for incident 1769991000. Recurring patterns: early-morning throughput drop (01:30-03:30 UTC) and sharp p95 spikes around 12:00 UTC. Need action owners for SLO windowing + fallback.
Omar: I can own SLO change PRs. Proposal: p95 interactive = 260ms (09:00-18:00 UTC), 340ms otherwise. Add throughput SLO for batch: 160 qps 24h.
Hiro: I'll take autoscaler tuning. Suggest increase scale-down cooldown to 15m and add a warm-pool of 1 node overnight.
Tess: I'll do dashboard updates and add an "active-fallbacks" panel showing fallback variant and traffic %. Also add hourly heatmap.
Nina: Error-budget policy: if burn > 25% in 30m then trigger quantized-model fallback and notify oncall. Hiro to implement fallback hook.
Hiro: Will add hook and a small synthetic at 02:00 to keep a pod warm. Will measure cost.
Omar: Timeline: dashboards (Tess) by Fri 2024-06-07; SLO PR (Omar) by Mon 2024-06-10; autoscaler & fallback (Hiro) by Wed 2024-06-12.
ci-bot: POSTMORTEM: 1769991000 resolved. Report: https://redwood.internal/pm/1769991000
Tess: Dashboard stub pushed: https://grafana.redwood/d/slo/1769991111 - linking Jira now.
Nina: Cool. We'll reconvene next Wed 2024-06-12 14:00 UTC to review burn-rate. If blockers, post short updates here.
